title: Design and Public Health
description: The focus of this project-based class is on teaching students fundamentals in design, with a particular focus on human-centered design and community-centered design. By the end of the course, students will have developed personal skills in using their chosen design approach (human- or community-centered design) and worked to advance and provide support to real-world partners of the professor. Students will also engage in a self-study project. Prerequisites: must be enrolled in MPH program (PB75 and PB90) or program approval. Renumbered from FMPH 460. Students may not receive credit for both FMPH 460 and PH 460.
